headline: SEC investigates Nvidia's accounting practices after changes in sales reports, according to media
summary: Media reports say the SEC is examining whether Nvidia's financial disclosures misled investors, with its Singapore-related operations facing closer scrutiny.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so disclosure questions about its revenue reporting are closely watched by investors across the semiconductor sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The SEC probe concerns Nvidia's own financial disclosures, which bear directly on the company's shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
